description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'Order' controller within the OpenCart admin module for sale orders. It handles listing, filtering, and displaying order data along with managing view components for the admin sale order management interface.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale orders in the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods for listing, filtering, and viewing detailed order information.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale orders in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for displaying order details, products, vouchers, totals, and related customer and store information.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of orders with filters and actions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the order list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the HTML or JSON list of orders based on current filters and sorting.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific order, including the ability to view invoice, shipping, and other order-related data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to initialize and render the order detail page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles rendering of the order list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the list of orders based on filters.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific order, including products, vouchers, totals, customer data, and subscriptions.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Handles API requests for order-related data, returning JSON responses based on request parameters and permissions.

methods.name: invoice
methods.description: Generates the invoice view for a specified order.

methods.name: shipping
methods.description: Displays the shipping details of an order, including address formatting and related store info.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history/log of an order, including status updates and comments.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the order's history entries for display.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an invoice number for an order, with permission check.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Handles the addition of rewards to an order.
